# M0 XBRL Golden Fixtures

These fixture payloads are deterministic SEC `companyfacts` samples used to validate
the M0 XBRL-to-canonical mapping logic without live network calls.

- `aapl_companyfacts_sample.json`
- `jpm_companyfacts_sample.json`
- `xom_companyfacts_sample.json`

Each file keeps only the minimal `facts.us-gaap` structure required by the mapper.
